rationale: Registry of canonical path strings (filesystem paths, package paths, executable arguments). When a path is renamed/moved, add the deprecated form to this registry so path-canonical-ripple.ts flags every surviving occurrence in the configured scope. Keep entries focused on string forms that machines verify; semantic recasts (e.g. Tier-8-vs-Tier-1 framing changes) belong in the failure-mode catalog audit layer instead.

paths.note: Plan-023 Tier 1 partial substrate carve-out collapsed shell/renderer into a single apps/desktop workspace. Deprecated forms are written without the trailing slash on purpose — `git grep -F` is a substring match, so `apps/desktop/shell` catches BOTH the literal-path form (`apps/desktop/shell/foo.ts`) AND the executable / CLI form (`pnpm rebuild --filter=apps/desktop/shell better-sqlite3`); the latter is the form that escaped the original PR #24 review per failure-mode-catalog.md row CAT-01. docs/archive/** retains historical references; docs/operations/failure-mode-catalog.md documents the failure pattern itself and must contain the literal deprecated string.

Plan-005 owns the provider driver tree at packages/runtime-daemon/src/provider/drivers/ per cross-plan-dependencies.md section 2. The deprecated spelling never existed on disk -- it entered Plan-005 T3.16 at the 2026-08-18 provider-account amendment and was repaired 2026-08-25 by the provider-bound text-neutrality amendment; the registry guards a canonicalization, which the schema's own description admits alongside renames and moves. The deprecated form carries the full packages/runtime-daemon/ prefix on purpose: git grep -F is a substring match, so the bare src/drivers/ fragment used in erratum-explaining prose does not match, and neither does the canonical form, which has provider/ between src/ and drivers.

The daemon provider directory is singular -- packages/runtime-daemon/src/provider/, holding provider-registry.ts, runtime-binding-store.ts, driver-capabilities-writer.ts, provider-output-validation.ts, and __tests__/. The plural spelling entered Plan-005 T3.17 at the 2026-08-18 amendment and was repaired 2026-08-25. Substring-safe against the canonical form, whose next character after provider is a slash rather than an s.
